## Introduction

I completed the required CITI training for human subjects research through California State Polytechnic University, Pomona.

## CITI Training Completion

I completed the College of Business Administration module, including the CPP Introduction to Human Subjects 101 module, international research, and internet-based research training.

The training covered human subjects protection, informed consent, privacy and confidentiality, risks, vulnerable populations, IRB review, and conflicts of interest.

## Certificate

![CITI Training Certificate](certificate.png)

## Conclusion

This training helped me understand the ethical principles and procedures required when conducting research involving human subjects.
